description: Retrieve global TBA insights for a season (or all-time with year 0) in one category. leaderboard ranks teams, events, or matches by a value; streak lists consecutive achievements; timeseries gives values over weeks or years; game_stats gives per-season, per-week, and per-event game statistics (very large, about 650 KB for 2025); clubs lists teams that reached all-time milestones. Each insight has name, display_name, year, category, and a category-specific data object. For a recent season the leaderboard category is about 300 KB; streak, timeseries, and clubs are small.

category.description: Insight category: 'leaderboard' (teams, events, or matches ranked by a value), 'streak' (consecutive achievements), 'timeseries' (values over weeks or years), 'game_stats' (per-season, per-week, and per-event game statistics; large), or 'clubs' (all-time milestone memberships).

anyOf.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

year.description: FRC season year the insights cover (1992 through next calendar year), or 0 for all-time insights across every season.

name: get_insights_by_category
title: Get Season Insights by Category
